rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a brain-inspired personal AI agent focused on private, local-first deployment, while Sharon's team at TheAgentic.Ai is architecting production-ready AI agent infrastructure across biotech, healthtech, and fintech. Steven's deep technical background in TypeScript/Rust and conviction around UI-first consumer AI complements Sharon's focus on agentic infrastructure, creating potential for collaboration on making personal AI agents production-ready across verticals.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Sharon — you're both building in the AI agent space from different angles (Steven on the consumer/local side, Sharon on enterprise infrastructure), and your technical stacks and deployment philosophies could inform each other's roadmaps.
